meta.title: Application name, copied from the PRD.
meta.updated_at: Date this usecase artifact was last written (YYYY-MM-DD).

ver: Version counter. Starts at 1; incremented on every write.
id: Usecase ID matching the entry in usecase-index, e.g. 'usecase-001--login'.
name: Short human-readable name, e.g. 'User Login'.
description: One paragraph describing what this usecase accomplishes from a business perspective.
actors: List of actor IDs (from actor-index) who participate in this usecase.
preconditions: Conditions that must be true before this usecase can start.

main_flow.actor: Who performs this step — actor ID or 'System'.
main_flow.description: What happens in this step, described in business terms.

alternative_flows.name: Short name for this alternative, e.g. 'Wrong password'.
alternative_flows.trigger: At which step and under what condition does this alternative start.
alternative_flows.steps: List of steps in this alternative flow, each step as a plain-text string.

postconditions: The state of the system after this usecase completes successfully.
business_rules: Business rules or constraints that specifically govern this usecase.

bdd_scenarios.scenario: Short scenario name, e.g. 'Successful login' or 'Login fails — wrong password'.
bdd_scenarios.given: Pre-condition in business terms — what state must exist before the action.
bdd_scenarios.when: The action the actor performs, described in business terms.
bdd_scenarios.then: The expected outcome from a business perspective.

related_screen_ids: Screens where this usecase is fulfilled (references screen-index). Many-to-many.
